\"bindings-table--key\",\n        \"bindings-table--description\",\n        \"bindings-table--divider\",\n        \"bindings-table--header\",\n    }\n\n    DEFAULT_CSS = \"\"\"\n    BindingsTable {\n        width: auto;\n        height: auto;\n    }\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def render_bindings_table(self) -> Table:\n        \"\"\"Render a table with all the key bindings.\n\n        Returns:\n            A Rich Table.\n        \"\"\"\n\n        bindings = self.screen.active_bindings.values()\n\n        key_style = self.get_component_rich_style(\"bindings-table--key\")\n        divider_transparent = (\n            self.get_component_styles(\"bindings-table--divider\").color.a == 0\n        )\n        table = Table(\n            padding=(0, 0),\n            show_header=False,\n            box=box.SIMPLE if divider_transparent else box.HORIZONTALS,\n            border_style=self.get_component_rich_style(\"bindings-table--divider\"),\n        )\n        table.add_column(\"\", justify=\"right\")\n\n        header_style = self.get_component_rich_style(\"bindings-table--header\")\n        previous_namespace: object = None\n        for namespace, _bindings in groupby(bindings, key=itemgetter(0)):\n            table_bindings = list(_bindings)\n            if not table_bindings:\n                continue\n\n            if namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE:\n                title = Text(namespace.BINDING_GROUP_TITLE, end=\"\")\n                title.stylize(header_style)\n                table.add_row(\"\", title)\n\n            action_to_bindings: defaultdict[str, list[tuple[Binding, bool, str]]]\n            action_to_bindings = defaultdict(list)\n            for _, binding, enabled, tooltip in table_bindings:\n                if not binding.system:\n                    action_to_bindings[binding.action].append(\n                        (binding, enabled, tooltip)\n                    )\n\n            description_style = self.get_component_rich_style(\n                \"bindings-table--description\"\n            )\n\n            def render_description(binding: Binding) -> Text:\n                \"\"\"Render description text from a binding.\"\"\"\n                text = Text.from_markup(\n                    binding.description, end=\"\", style=description_style\n                )\n                if binding.tooltip:\n                    text.append(\" \")\n                    text.append(binding.tooltip, \"dim\")\n                return text\n\n            get_key_display = self.app.get_key_display\n            for multi_bindings in action_to_bindings.values():\n                binding, enabled, tooltip = multi_bindings[0]\n                keys_display = \" \".join(\n                    dict.fromkeys(  # Remove duplicates while preserving order\n                        get_key_display(binding) for binding, _, _ in multi_bindings\n                    )\n                )\n                table.add_row(\n                    Text(keys_display, style=key_style),\n                    render_description(binding),\n                )\n            if namespace != previous_namespace:\n                table.add_section()\n\n            previous_namespace = namespace\n\n        return table\n\n    def render(self) -> Table:\n        return self.render_bindings_table()\n\n\nclass KeyPanel(VerticalScroll, can_focus=False):\n    \"\"\"\n    Shows bindings for currently focused widget.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    DEFAULT_CSS = \"\"\"\n    KeyPanel {                    \n        split: right;\n        width: 33%;\n        min-width: 30;              \n        max-width: 60;    \n        border-left: vkey $foreground 30%;\n        padding: 0 1;\n        height: 1fr;\n        padding-right: 1;\n        align: center top;\n\n        &> .bindings-table--description {\n            color: $foreground;\n        }\n\n        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--divider {\n            color: transparent;\n        }\n\n        &> BindingsTable > .bindings-table--header {\n            text-style: dim italic;\n        }\n\n        #bindings-table {\n            width: auto;\n            height: auto;\n        }      \n    }\n    \"\"\"\n\n    DEFAULT_CLASSES = \"-textual-system\"\n\n    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:\n        yield BindingsTable(shrink=True, expand=False)\n\n    async def on_mount(self) -> None:\n        async def bindings_changed(screen: Screen) -> None:\n            if not screen.app.app_focus:\n                return\n            if self.is_attached and screen is self.screen:\n                self.refresh(recompose=True)\n\n        self.set_class(self.app.ansi_color, \"-ansi-scrollbar\")\n        self.screen.bindings_updated_signal.subscribe(self, bindings_changed)\n\n    def width=height=bitd=ctype=None; idat=b''; plte=None\nwhile i<len(data):\n    ln=struct.unpack('>I',data[i:i+4])[0]; typ=data[i+4:i+8]; chunk=data[i+8:i+8+ln]; i+=12+ln\n    if typ==b'IHDR':\n        width,height,bitd,ctype=struct.unpack('>IIBB',chunk[:10])\n    elif typ==b'IDAT': idat+=chunk\n    elif typ==b'PLTE': plte=chunk\n    elif typ==b'IEND': break\nprint('w,h,bitd,ctype',width,height,bitd,ctype)\nraw=zlib.decompress(idat)\nch={0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[ctype]\nbpp=ch*bitd//8\nstride=width*bpp\ndef paeth(a,b,c):\n    p=a+b-c; pos+=stride\n    if f==1:\n        for x in range(bpp,stride): line[x]=(line[x]+line[x-bpp])&255\n    elif f==2:\n        for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+prev[x])&255\n    elif f==3:\n        for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+((line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0)+prev[x])//2)&255\n    elif f==4:\n        for x in range(stride):\n            a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0; note\n            You can implement this in a subclass if you want to change how keys are displayed in your app.\n\n        Args:\n            binding: A Binding.\n\n        Returns:\n            A string used to represent the key.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Dev has overridden the key display, so use that\n        if binding.key_display:\n            return binding.key_display\n\n        # Extract modifiers\n        modifiers, key = binding.parse_key()\n\n        # Format the key (replace unicode names with character)\n        key = format_key(key)\n\n        # Convert ctrl modifier to caret\n        if \"ctrl\" in modifiers:\n            modifiers.pop(modifiers.index(\"ctrl\"))\n            key = f\"^{key}\"\n        # Join everything with +\n        key_tokens = modifiers + [key]\n        return \"+\".join(key_tokens)\n","numLines":30,"startLine":1766,"totalLines":4641}}}

await pilot.pause()\n        svg = app.export_screenshot()\n    xs=[]\n    for m in re.finditer(r'<text[^>]*\\bx=\"([\\d.]+)\"[^>]*\\by=\"([\\d.]+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</text>', svg):\n        x,y,t=float(m.group(1)),float(m.group(2)),m.group(3)\n        if t.strip() and t.strip()!='▏': xs.append((round(y),round(x),t))\n    return xs\n\nasync def main():\n    for w in [40,50,60,70,80,90,100,120]:\n        xs = await run((w,24))\n        # description column: find the x that is NOT the key column and appears most;
